title: Internal: Closing/Cancelling a Debit Card
summary: This document explains how to close, cancel, or deactivate a debit card, including eligibility checks (ACTIVE/PENDING status, no pending transactions, no pending refunds, min 14-day card age based on date_issued) and immediate closure for lost/stolen/fraud_suspected. It details required verification steps, the reason selection flow, and closing via close_debit_card_4721(card_id, reason), plus post-closure impacts (no reactivation, update recurring payments, refund credits to linked checking).
faqs: How do I close or deactivate my debit card, and what reasons are allowed?
What eligibility requirements must be met before a card can be closed (pending transactions, pending refunds, card age, and status)?
If my card is lost, stolen, or fraud suspected, will I be able to close it immediately even if it’s less than 14 days old?
If there are pending transactions or pending refunds, what do I need to do before closure can proceed?
What happens after the card is permanently deactivated—can it be reactivated, and what about recurring payments and refunds?
If I’m closing the linked checking account, is there anything I must do with associated debit cards first?
keywords: reason (lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed, account_closing)
Pending refunds block closure (3–5 business days)
Refunds credited to linked checking account
